summary:
Expanded architectural blueprint incorporating:
1. Complete Canva-grade Document Editor in FORGE: 4K pixel-perfect canvas rendering, fully editable text boxes and interactive checkboxes, 30-step deep undo/redo history (15 reverse / 15 forward snapshots), AI alignment & copy refinement suggestions with visual overlay highlights, prompt-driven document modifications, and high-fidelity PDF/PNG export.
2. WCAG AA contrast compliance across Primary Navigation and Hero (>9:1 with #D4AF37 and #E5C158) and eradication of all harsh in-between white line seams.
3. Living CSS-only fixed atmospheric backgrounds per section (Home, Tools, Book of Lies, Marketplace, Community, Signal, About, and Admin) with zero layout jank and prefers-reduced-motion support.
4. Asymmetric Bento Grid Matrix in Playground: 12-col desktop layout featuring FORGE (7-col featured with parsing bars), PRIME Oracle (5-col conversation loop), MIRAGE (5-col shimmer swatches), and SENTINEL (12-col slim full-width audit bar).
5. The Sanctuary Vault Menu redesign: purged Admin Recovery, translucent bubble chambers with navigation hints, sector filters, and draggable trigger knob.
6. Floating PRIME Guide Bee (/components/prime/GuideBee.tsx): floating Metatron orb with playful AI moods, 4s onboarding tooltip, slide-up chat console with Groq LLM routing and fallback, DOM target highlighting, and persistent localStorage memory.
